classification.difficultyReason: Students must halve the perimeter to obtain the sum of adjacent sides, divide that sum in the given ratio, then multiply the dimensions for area. Selecting and linking these familiar procedures supplies the demand.

content.prompt:
The perimeter of a rectangle is $50\text{ cm}$. The dimensions of the rectangle are in the ratio $4:1$.

Work out the area of the rectangle.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}
\text{Length}+\text{width} &= 50\div2=25\text{ cm}\\
\text{Total parts} &= 4+1=5\\
1\text{ part} &= 25\div5=5\text{ cm}\\
\text{Length} &= 4\times5=20\text{ cm}\\
\text{Width} &= 5\text{ cm}\\
\text{Area} &= 20\times5=100\text{ cm}^2
\end{align*}$$
